summary.text: Bennie Cook is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 143 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Cook is a former deputy sheriff who lives in Houston, Missouri.

paragraphs.text: Bennie Cook lives in Houston, Missouri.
He earned an associate degree in human services and a bachelor's degree in criminal justice administration from Columbia College.

His career experience includes working in law enforcement, including as a Texas County deputy sheriff, as director of the Texas County Food Pantry, and as a field representative for Congressman Jason Smith.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee and a member of the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee.
